name: LitTwoAnchor
description:
Client-side | Beta
LitTwoAnchor is an early beta anchor placement optimizer, built from an idea by Dr_LitTwo and vibe-coded with a lot of help from Claude. It speeds up placing Respawn Anchors and charging them with glowstone, and only kicks in when you're holding an anchor, glowstone or a totem. Expect a few bugs and changes while it's still being worked on.
Features: adjustable placement speed, faster placing for anchors, glowstone and totems, and toggle and speed keys you can rebind in Controls.
Status: Beta, a work in progress.
